quarterly_data.quarter: Wärtsilä press release: Wrtsil to deliver engines for Australia's largest-ever (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Order (release): Wärtsilä was selected to supply Wärtsilä 46TS engines for what it calls Australia's largest-ever reciprocating engine power plant, a 300 MW plant for grid balancing and system security that will operate 13 Wärtsilä 46TS-SG gas engines (able to run on up to a 25 vol-% hydrogen blend); the customer is not named. Booked in Q3 2026; equipment delivery is scheduled for early 2029 and the plant is expected to become fully operational the following year.
quarterly_data.figure: 300 MW; 13 Wärtsilä 46TS-SG engines; booked Q3 2026; delivery early 2029
